market_summary: Day 1 rally attempt. Nasdaq +3% but equal-weight RSP DOWN ~1% — lopsided short-covering bounce. Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness LP liquidated at 4x leverage, prime brokers dumping AI longs (NBIS, CRWV, MU, SNDK, BE, AMD, ORCL) and short options vs NVDA/SMH. Webster: 'Stay in first/second gear — this is a scary market.' 10yr at 4.66%. Equal-weight indexes (RSP, QQQE) holding above 21-day. Study 1999 bar-by-bar.

FTNT.technical_action: Surging off earnings, faded from morning gap
FTNT.story: Fortinet: beat EPS views, 26% revenue gain. Strong cybersecurity demand.

TENB.story: Tenable: beat slightly on EPS/revenue, guided in line. Good news sold aggressively.

QCOM.story: Qualcomm: just missed EPS, beat on revenue, guided up Q4 revenue at midpoint.

LRCX.story: Lam Research: beat EPS, slightly beat revenue (+30%). Semi-equipment strength.

ARM.technical_action: Beat, +23% revenue; phone weakness offset by data center strength
ARM.story: ARM Holdings: guided slightly higher on Q2. Data center demand the driver.

SIMO.technical_action: Easily beat with +127% revenue, guided up Q3
SIMO.story: Silicon Motion: NAND flash controller maker explosive quarter.

DDOG.technical_action: Cup-with-handle setup, RSI blue dot, RS strong
DDOG.story: Datadog (Arnie's highlight): bullish momentum ahead of earnings in 7 days. Classic technical setup with relative strength holding up.

SNOW.technical_action: Caution on sustainability of tech momentum
SNOW.story: Snowflake: Webster questions whether tech names can sustain moves given "chop and slop" volatility.

SNDK.story: SanDisk: explosive quarter but forced selling from Aschenbrenner fund liquidation.

MSFT.technical_action: Gapped above 200-day, provided key support for indexes
MSFT.story: Microsoft: massive market cap — panel saw move as potential liquidity event (institutions selling into strength) rather than clean breakout.

SBUX.technical_action: Q3 EPS beat, slight revenue decline, traded strongly on raised guidance
SBUX.story: Starbucks: turnaround narrative gaining traction. Guidance raise the key.

YUM.technical_action: Slightly beat EPS, missed revenue on cyclospora outbreak at Taco Bell
YUM.story: Yum! Brands: temporary headwind already improving.

CMG.technical_action: Beat EPS, slightly missed revenue (9%); fresh lettuce fears
CMG.story: Chipotle: temporary fears hurt late July sales. Gapping up slightly on reassurance.

SHEL.story: Shell: energy major returning capital to shareholders.

CVNA.story: Carvana: strong growth but guidance weighs.

NBIS.story: Nebius: AI infrastructure name in Aschenbrenner liquidation basket. Track for bounce once selling clears.

CRWV.story: CoreWeave: AI compute name in hedge fund unwind.

BE.technical_action: Caught in forced liquidation; deep 40-50% correction
BE.story: Bloom Energy: AI-adjacent clean energy. Correction similar to historical leader patterns. Hatman Dave discussed covered calls.

AMD.story: AMD: AI chip name in forced deleveraging basket.

ORCL.story: Oracle: AI infrastructure name in liquidation basket.

MU.technical_action: Caught in forced liquidation; SMH -29% correction
MU.story: Micron: both liquidation victim and name to watch for recovery. Memory sector under severe pressure.

NVDA.story: Nvidia: options market impact from fund unwind.

SMH.story: Semiconductor ETF: severe drawdown in chips.

CRS.technical_action: Beat EPS, slightly missed revenue (+13%); severe pullback on CEO passing
CRS.story: Carpenter Technology: unexpected passing of CEO last Friday. Hatman Dave discussed covered calls/hedges.

HOOD.technical_action: Beat EPS (one-time boost), slightly beat revenue
HOOD.story: Robinhood: prediction markets up, crypto down.

GVA.story: Power/heavy construction: accelerating growth and strong order book.

WWD.technical_action: Beat EPS, in-line revenue, narrowed guidance

QQQE.story: Equal-weight Nasdaq: same signal as RSP.
